entries.en: We stopped where the old telford disappeared beneath a layer of fallen leaves.
entries.zh: 我们在旧泰尔福特路面被一层落叶遮住的地方停了下来。

entries.en: Howell caught the wobbling bowl before any soup spilled onto the carpet.
entries.zh: 豪厄尔扶住了晃动的碗，没让汤洒到地毯上。

entries.en: A folded blanket awaited us on the sofa in our rented room in Maidstone.
entries.zh: 我们在梅德斯通租的房间里，沙发上已经备好了一条叠好的毯子。

entries.en: The designer sent Cadbury a sample of the revised wrapper on Friday.
entries.zh: 星期五，设计师给吉百利公司寄去了一份修改后的包装纸样品。

entries.en: Conway slipped on the loose rug but managed to keep the tray level.
entries.zh: 康韦踩到松动的地毯滑了一下，却设法保持托盘平稳。

entries.en: Our friends in Barnsley had cleared a drawer for the baby's clothes.
entries.zh: 我们在巴恩斯利的朋友腾出了一个抽屉，准备放婴儿的衣服。

entries.en: Patterson forgot the joke halfway through and began laughing at his own confusion.
entries.zh: 帕特森讲到一半忘了笑话的内容，反而笑起了自己的糊涂。

entries.en: She kept the photographs of the Mersey in a separate blue envelope.
entries.zh: 她把默西河的照片放在一个单独的蓝色信封里。

entries.en: We reached Stockport after discovering that our suitcase had been loaded onto another coach.
entries.zh: 发现行李箱被装上了另一辆长途客车后，我们才抵达斯托克波特。

entries.en: The worn barlow lay beside a spool of string on the workbench.
entries.zh: 那把磨旧的巴洛折刀放在工作台上，旁边是一卷绳子。

entries.en: Woolwich propped the cupboard door open while I replaced the missing screw.
entries.zh: 我装上缺失的螺钉时，伍尔维奇撑着柜门，让它开着。

entries.en: The currie had cooled by the time we found the missing plates.
entries.zh: 我们找到不见的盘子时，咖哩饭菜已经凉了。

entries.en: Whitbread had nearly finished the letter when a drop of coffee blurred the address.
entries.zh: 惠特布雷德快写完信时，一滴咖啡把地址弄模糊了。

entries.en: The journal described a journey through Glamorgan with a cart full of broken furniture.
entries.zh: 日记记述了带着一辆装满破家具的车穿越格拉摩根郡的旅程。

entries.en: Ryder pushed the gate shut with his shoulder while carrying the muddy boots.
entries.zh: 瑞得拿着沾泥的靴子，用肩膀把门推上了。

entries.en: An old letter from Notts fell out when she opened the photograph album.
entries.zh: 她打开相册时，一封从诺丁汉郡寄来的旧信掉了出来。

entries.en: During the demonstration, Veronica returned a menu that the instructor projected onto the wall.
entries.zh: 演示时，Veronica 查找程序返回了一个菜单，讲师把它投影在墙上。

entries.en: Simmons offered to hold the ladder but insisted that we move it away from the roses.
entries.zh: 西蒙斯提出帮忙扶梯子，但坚持让我们把梯子移开，远离玫瑰花丛。

entries.en: The suitcase we left in Mackay contained nothing but costumes and a broken clock.
entries.zh: 我们留在麦基的行李箱里，只有戏服和一只坏钟。

entries.en: Lennox tried to rescue the newspaper before the wet dog sat on it.
entries.zh: 伦诺克斯试图赶在那只湿狗坐上去之前，把报纸拿开。

entries.en: Goodwin stood back to judge whether the picture was hanging straight.
entries.zh: 古德温退后几步，看看那幅画是否挂正了。

entries.en: Liam found a walnut in his coat pocket and could not remember putting it there.
entries.zh: 利亚姆在外套口袋里发现了一颗核桃，却不记得自己什么时候放进去的。

entries.en: Mikhail rolled up his sleeves before reaching into the flooded drawer.
entries.zh: 米哈伊尔卷起袖子，才把手伸进灌了水的抽屉里。

entries.en: Gallagher put the cracked cup aside so that nobody would use it by mistake.
entries.zh: 加拉格尔把那只有裂纹的杯子放到一旁，免得有人误用。

entries.en: Carrington caught the loose curtain before it landed in the washing-up water.
entries.zh: 卡林顿抓住了松脱的窗帘，没让它落进洗碗水里。

entries.en: Our last evening in Gateshead was spent trying to close an overfilled suitcase.
entries.zh: 在盖茨黑德的最后一个晚上，我们一直试着合上塞得太满的行李箱。

entries.en: Tessa drew a small star beside the recipe that had worked best.
entries.zh: 泰萨在效果最好的那份食谱旁边画了一颗小星星。

entries.en: Selby looked beneath the cushions and found the missing domino.
entries.zh: 塞尔比查看了坐垫下面，找到了不见的那张多米诺骨牌。

entries.en: The parcel reached our old flat in Birkenhead a day after we moved out.
entries.zh: 我们搬走一天后，包裹送到了伯肯黑德的旧公寓。

entries.en: The archive contained letters from Wrexham about an election held many years earlier.
entries.zh: 档案里有从雷克瑟姆寄来的信，谈的是多年前的一场选举。

entries.en: Gascoigne shook the snow from his hat before stepping into the crowded kitchen.
entries.zh: 加斯科因掸掉帽子上的雪，才走进拥挤的厨房。

entries.en: Hassan balanced the empty flowerpot on his knee while looking for the matching saucer.
entries.zh: 哈山把空花盆稳放在膝上，寻找与它相配的托碟。

entries.en: We left Abingdon with two borrowed umbrellas and no idea where our own had gone.
entries.zh: 我们离开阿宾顿时，拿着两把借来的伞，却不知道自己的伞去了哪里。

entries.en: Menzies lowered the crate gently after hearing something rattle inside.
entries.zh: 孟席斯听到箱子里有东西碰撞作响，便轻轻把箱子放低。

entries.en: Isobel unpicked the crooked seam rather than hiding it beneath a ribbon.
entries.zh: 伊泽贝尔拆开了歪斜的缝线，没有用丝带把它遮住。

entries.en: The old map of Antrim had been folded so often that its corners were missing.
entries.zh: 那张安特里姆郡的旧地图折叠过太多次，角都缺了。

entries.en: Delors kept one hand on the box while searching for the packing tape.
entries.zh: 德洛尔一只手按着箱子，同时寻找封箱胶带。

entries.en: Our hosts in Armagh lent us a pan big enough for the entire meal.
entries.zh: 我们在阿尔马的接待者借给我们一口锅，大得足以做整顿饭。

entries.en: Philippa held the torn page against the light to read the faded pencil marks.
entries.zh: 菲利帕把撕破的书页举到光下，辨认褪色的铅笔字迹。

entries.en: Moran waited until the kettle stopped boiling before trying to hear the message again.
entries.zh: 莫兰等水壶不再沸腾，才又试着听那条留言。

entries.en: Mosley wrapped the glass ornament in a scarf before putting it in his bag.
entries.zh: 莫斯利用围巾裹好玻璃饰物，才放进包里。

entries.en: Hendry stopped the runaway trolley with his foot before it hit the gate.
entries.zh: 亨德里用脚拦住了滑走的手推车，没让它撞上门。

entries.en: A patched tarpaulin covered part of the Romanesque doorway during our visit.
entries.zh: 我们参观时，一块打着补丁的防水布遮住了那道罗马式门口的一部分。

entries.en: Our room in Wexford had a cupboard too narrow for either suitcase.
entries.zh: 我们在韦克斯福德住的房间里，柜子窄得放不下任何一个行李箱。

entries.en: Keegan tilted the box and heard the last marble roll into a corner.
entries.zh: 基根倾斜箱子，听见最后一颗弹珠滚进了角落。

entries.en: Fairfax brushed the flour from his cuffs before answering the telephone.
entries.zh: 费尔法克斯掸掉袖口上的面粉，才去接电话。

entries.en: Dustin tried the spare bulb and discovered that the lamp itself was faulty.
entries.zh: 达斯汀试了备用灯泡，才发现是灯本身出了毛病。

entries.en: Maisie kept the little paper crown long after the birthday party had ended.
entries.zh: 生日聚会结束很久后，梅齐还留着那顶小纸王冠。

entries.en: Althusser put the muddy umbrella in the bathtub rather than on the wooden floor.
entries.zh: 阿尔都塞把沾泥的伞放进浴缸，而不是放在木地板上。

entries.en: Lennie searched the shed for a piece of wood to brace the broken chair.
entries.zh: 伦尼在棚屋里寻找一块木头，用来加固坏椅子。

entries.en: We arrived in Northallerton just as the strap on my bag finally broke.
entries.zh: 我们刚到诺思阿勒尔顿，我包上的带子就终于断了。

entries.en: Cleo held the candle away from the curtains while we searched for the fuse box.
entries.zh: 我们寻找保险丝盒时，克利奥举着蜡烛，避开窗帘。

entries.en: Noriega shook the rug over the balcony and uncovered a forgotten silver button.
entries.zh: 诺列加在阳台外抖地毯，抖出了一颗被遗忘的银色纽扣。

entries.en: Urquhart took the longer path because the muddy shortcut would ruin his shoes.
entries.zh: 厄克特选择了较远的路，因为泥泞的近道会弄坏他的鞋。

entries.en: Elinor carefully removed the wet photograph from beneath the dripping vase.
entries.zh: 埃莉诺小心地从滴水的花瓶下面拿出了湿照片。

entries.en: Quigley forgot which pocket held the key and began emptying them all.
entries.zh: 奎格利忘了钥匙放在哪个口袋里，开始把所有口袋都掏空。

entries.en: Flavia pushed the last chair against the wall to make room for the dancers.
entries.zh: 弗莱维娅把最后一把椅子推到墙边，给跳舞的人腾地方。

entries.en: Theodora kept stirring even after she realised the saucepan was empty.
entries.zh: 西奥多拉意识到煮锅已经空了，却仍在搅拌。

entries.en: Stoddard placed a cushion beneath the sleeping cat instead of moving it.
entries.zh: 斯托达德在熟睡的猫身下垫了个靠垫，没有把猫移走。

entries.en: Nicolo rescued the scarf from the closing lift doors with a quick tug.
entries.zh: 尼科洛迅速一拽，从正在关闭的电梯门间拉回了围巾。

entries.en: Vitor reached into the coat sleeve and pulled out the missing mitten.
entries.zh: 维托尔把手伸进外套袖子，取出了不见的连指手套。

entries.en: Fabia stopped the argument by producing the receipt everyone had been looking for.
entries.zh: 法比亚拿出大家一直在找的收据，平息了争论。

entries.en: Eline placed the flowers in a bucket until we could find a suitable vase.
entries.zh: 埃利纳把花放在桶里，等我们找到合适的花瓶。

entries.en: The parcel slipped from my bag while we were crossing Piccadilly.
entries.zh: 我们穿过皮卡迪利大街时，包裹从我的包里滑了出来。

entries.en: Our borrowed car in Clapham had a boot already filled with gardening tools.
entries.zh: 我们在克拉彭借到的汽车，后备厢里已经装满了园艺工具。

entries.en: An old postcard of Eton was tucked between the pages of the diary.
entries.zh: 日记的书页之间夹着一张伊顿公学的旧明信片。

entries.en: The scarf I lost in Guildford turned up inside my other suitcase.
entries.zh: 我在吉尔福德丢失的围巾，后来竟出现在另一个行李箱里。

entries.en: Bartholomew caught the rolling orange just before it disappeared beneath the fridge.
entries.zh: 巴塞洛缪赶在滚动的橙子钻进冰箱底下之前抓住了它。

entries.en: We spent the wait at Gatwick repairing a torn strap on the baby's bag.
entries.zh: 在盖特威克机场等候时，我们一直在修补婴儿包上撕裂的带子。

entries.en: The room we borrowed in Lambeth smelled faintly of fresh paint.
entries.zh: 我们在朗伯斯区借住的房间里，有一股淡淡的新油漆味。

entries.en: Alastair rested the heavy suitcase on a step and flexed his aching fingers.
entries.zh: 阿拉斯泰尔把沉重的行李箱搁在台阶上，活动了一下酸痛的手指。

entries.en: The old Latin map placed Britannia close to the edge of the sheet.
entries.zh: 那张旧拉丁文地图把大不列颠画在靠近纸张边缘的位置。

entries.en: Henri put a finger to his lips when the floorboard began to creak.
entries.zh: 地板开始嘎吱作响时，亨利把一根手指放到唇边，示意安静。

entries.en: Our friends in Southwark kept a spare pair of boots beneath the kitchen table.
entries.zh: 我们在萨瑟克区的朋友把一双备用靴子放在厨房桌下。

entries.en: We returned to Eastbourne to collect the bag we had left behind.
entries.zh: 我们返回伊斯特本，去取先前落下的包。

entries.en: Denise held the picture while we argued about which hook was strong enough.
entries.zh: 我们争论哪个挂钩足够牢固时，丹尼斯一直拿着那幅画。

entries.en: The borrowed suitcase arrived at our flat in Ealing without either of its keys.
entries.zh: 借来的行李箱送到我们在伊令的公寓时，两把钥匙都没随箱送来。

entries.en: A handwritten account of the journey through Argyll accompanied the faded photographs.
entries.zh: 那些褪色的照片旁，附着一份穿越阿盖尔郡旅程的手写记述。

entries.en: Newbury removed the loose tile before anyone could trip over it.
entries.zh: 纽伯里拿走了那块松动的瓷砖，免得有人被它绊倒。

entries.meaningZh: 英国海军部〔历史机构名〕
entries.en: The faded letter from the Admiralty was still sealed inside its envelope.
entries.zh: 那封来自英国海军部的旧信已经褪色，却仍封在信封里。

entries.en: We spent our first night in Basingstoke sleeping beside boxes of books we had not yet unpacked.
entries.zh: 在贝辛斯托克的第一个晚上，我们睡在一箱箱尚未取出的书旁边。

entries.en: Stephens lifted the lid carefully, expecting the frightened mouse to jump out.
entries.zh: 史蒂芬斯小心地掀起盖子，估计那只受惊的老鼠会跳出来。

entries.en: Our hosts in Taunton had left a warm blanket on each bed.
entries.zh: 我们在陶顿的接待者在每张床上都放了一条暖和的毯子。

entries.en: Callaghan found a second crack while washing the old mixing bowl.
entries.zh: 卡拉汉清洗旧搅拌碗时，又发现了第二道裂纹。

entries.en: Suzanne tied the curtains back to stop them brushing against the wet paint.
entries.zh: 苏珊娜把窗帘拢起扎好，免得碰到未干的油漆。

entries.en: Radcliffe handed me the wrong glasses and wondered why I still could not read.
entries.zh: 拉德克利夫递错了眼镜，还奇怪我为什么仍然看不清字。

entries.en: Thorne supported the broken shelf with one hand while reaching for the screwdriver.
entries.zh: 索恩一只手托住坏搁板，同时伸手去拿螺丝刀。

entries.en: Bromley turned the cushion over to hide the small coffee stain.
entries.zh: 布罗姆利翻过坐垫，遮住那一小块咖啡渍。

entries.en: Albans waited in the doorway until we had cleared the fallen books.
entries.zh: 奥尔本斯等在门口，直到我们清走了掉落的书。

entries.en: The box sent from Salford contained the missing lid but not the saucepan.
entries.zh: 从索尔福德寄来的箱子里有不见的锅盖，却没有锅。

entries.en: The angler lifted a dobson from the damp leaves in the bait tin.
entries.zh: 钓鱼人从饵料盒里的湿叶子中取出了一只鱼蛉幼虫。

entries.en: Walters moved the chair away from the wall so that I could reach the socket.
entries.zh: 沃尔特斯把椅子从墙边挪开，让我够到插座。

entries.en: Yvonne held the torn envelope shut while carrying the loose photographs upstairs.
entries.zh: 伊冯一边捏拢破信封口，一边拿着散放的照片上楼。

entries.en: Dickinson tapped the glass gently to wake the dozing ticket clerk.
entries.zh: 迪金森轻轻敲了敲玻璃，叫醒正在打盹的售票员。

entries.en: We arrived in Torquay with wet coats and a badly creased birthday card.
entries.zh: 我们到达托基时，外套湿着，还带着一张折皱得很厉害的生日贺卡。

entries.en: Larkin offered the last biscuit to the child waiting beside the door.
entries.zh: 拉金提出把最后一块饼干给那个等在门旁的孩子。

entries.en: The traveller spread his battered Bradshaw across the narrow railway compartment table.
entries.zh: 旅客在火车包厢那张狭窄的桌子上摊开了破旧的英国铁路时刻表。

entries.en: Ivor closed the cupboard quickly when the stack of plates began to lean.
entries.zh: 那叠盘子开始倾斜时，艾弗赶紧关上了橱柜。

entries.en: McKenzie tried to catch the dropping lid without letting go of the saucepan.
entries.zh: 麦肯齐试着接住掉落的锅盖，同时没有松开手里的锅。

entries.en: The umbrella we bought in Grimsby broke before we reached our rented room.
entries.zh: 我们在格里姆斯比买的伞，还没到租住的房间就坏了。

entries.en: Buxton had to remove the drawers before we could lift the desk.
entries.zh: 巴克斯顿不得不先卸下抽屉，我们才能抬起书桌。

entries.en: Allison slipped the loose photograph back beneath the album's transparent cover.
entries.zh: 艾利森把松脱的照片重新塞进了相册的透明封套下面。

entries.en: Schofield put the shopping down and helped us straighten the crooked gate.
entries.zh: 斯科菲尔德放下买来的东西，帮我们把歪斜的门扶正。

entries.en: Holloway climbed onto the stool to reach the forgotten parcel above the cupboard.
entries.zh: 霍洛韦爬上凳子，去够遗忘在橱柜上方的包裹。

entries.en: We left Walsall with a borrowed map and a promise to return it.
entries.zh: 我们离开沃尔索耳时，带着借来的地图，并答应会归还。

entries.en: Buckley wiped the muddy pawprints from the letter before opening it.
entries.zh: 巴克利擦去信上的泥爪印，才把信打开。

entries.en: Philippe caught his coat on the door handle and spilled the basket of pegs.
entries.zh: 菲力浦的外套被门把手挂住，打翻了一篮衣夹。

entries.en: Our room in Malvern overlooked a garden where a red scarf had caught on the fence.
entries.zh: 我们在莫尔文住的房间望出去是座花园，围栏上挂住了一条红围巾。

entries.en: Longman held the empty bag open while I gathered the scattered apples.
entries.zh: 我收拾散落的苹果时，朗曼撑开了空袋子。

entries.en: Leyland crouched behind the sofa to retrieve the escaped hamster.
entries.zh: 莱兰蹲到沙发后面，去捉跑掉的仓鼠。

entries.en: Bingham returned the borrowed drill with a note explaining the broken switch.
entries.zh: 宾汉归还借来的电钻时，附了一张说明开关损坏的纸条。

entries.en: Madge kept a finger on the loose page while searching for a paperclip.
entries.zh: 马奇用一根手指压着散页，同时寻找回形针。

entries.en: We found the missing tickets while unpacking our bags in Londonderry.
entries.zh: 我们在伦敦德里开箱整理行李时，找到了不见的票。

entries.en: Healey used the edge of a postcard to lift the dried wax.
entries.zh: 希利用一张明信片的边缘挑起了干蜡。

entries.en: The album of our visit to Vladimir had a pressed leaf between its final pages.
entries.zh: 记录我们弗拉基米尔之行的相册，最后几页之间夹着一片压平的树叶。

entries.en: Keating lowered the basket when he heard the kitten moving inside.
entries.zh: 基廷听见小猫在篮子里面动，便把篮子放低了。

entries.en: The envelope addressed to Abbott had been left in the wrong tray.
entries.zh: 那封寄给雅培公司的信被放错了收件盘。

entries.en: She wrapped the cracked jug in a stroud before placing it in the trunk.
entries.zh: 她把有裂纹的水罐裹进粗呢毯子，才放进大箱子里。

entries.en: Whitehouse stopped packing when he realised the suitcase belonged to somebody else.
entries.zh: 怀特豪斯发现行李箱是别人的，便停下了装箱的动作。

entries.meaningZh: 特威克纳姆〔英国选区名〕
entries.en: The old election file contained a bundle of letters from Twickenham.
entries.zh: 那份旧选举档案里有一捆从特威克纳姆寄来的信。

entries.en: Roberto caught the corner of the tablecloth before the cat pulled it off.
entries.zh: 罗伯托抓住了桌布的一角，没让猫把它扯下来。

entries.en: Sadler carried the empty cage outside without brushing against the doorframe's peeling paint.
entries.zh: 萨德勒把空笼子提到外面，没有碰到门框上剥落的油漆。

entries.en: Sylvester held the book open with his elbow while peeling an orange.
entries.zh: 西尔威斯特一边剥橙子，一边用胳膊肘压住摊开的书。

entries.en: Pringle found the missing chess piece inside the rolled-up picnic blanket.
entries.zh: 普林格尔在卷起的野餐毯里找到了遗失的棋子。

entries.en: Lilley stopped winding the clock when the small key began to bend.
entries.zh: 小钥匙开始变弯时，利利停止给钟上发条。

entries.en: A faded receipt from Herefordshire marked the page where I had stopped reading.
entries.zh: 一张来自赫里福郡的褪色收据，标记着我上次读到的那一页。

entries.en: Georgina balanced the cake tin on her lap throughout the bumpy journey.
entries.zh: 一路颠簸，乔治娜始终把蛋糕盒稳稳放在膝上。

entries.en: The old photographs from Grampian smelled faintly of the attic where they had been stored.
entries.zh: 那些来自格兰扁区的旧照片，隐约带着存放它们的阁楼的气味。

entries.en: Laing pressed the torn corner flat before sliding the poster into its frame.
entries.zh: 莱恩把撕破的一角压平，才将海报推进画框。

entries.en: Giovanni untied the damp shoelaces and left the boots beside the heater.
entries.zh: 乔瓦尼解开湿鞋带，把靴子留在暖气旁边。

entries.en: Lorna carefully removed a pine needle from the dog's thick coat.
entries.zh: 洛纳小心地从狗浓密的毛里取出一根松针。

entries.en: Jarvis turned the cracked plate over to check whether the damage reached the rim.
entries.zh: 贾维斯把有裂纹的盘子翻过来，查看破损是否延伸到了盘沿。

entries.en: Hewitt kept the empty chair for the neighbour who was bringing the spare key.
entries.zh: 休伊特把空椅子留给了那个要带备用钥匙来的邻居。

entries.en: McLean reached behind the radiator and recovered the fallen birthday card.
entries.zh: 麦克林把手伸到暖气片后面，取回了掉下去的生日贺卡。

entries.en: Horne put the glass down before telling us why his hands were shaking.
entries.zh: 霍恩先放下玻璃杯，才告诉我们他的双手为什么在抖。

entries.en: Berger rescued the newspaper from the puddle but could not save the crossword.
entries.zh: 伯杰从水洼里捞起了报纸，却没能保住上面的填字游戏。

entries.en: Johnstone offered to carry the cake, provided we opened every door for him.
entries.zh: 约翰斯通提出帮忙端蛋糕，条件是沿途每扇门都由我们替他打开。

entries.en: Samantha unrolled the damp map and weighed its curling corners down with mugs.
entries.zh: 萨曼莎展开湿地图，用杯子压住卷起的边角。

entries.en: The diary of our journey through Clwyd was filled with sketches of broken equipment.
entries.zh: 记录我们穿越克卢伊达郡之行的日记里，画满了损坏设备的草图。

entries.en: Farnham realised the coat was not his when he found a child's glove inside.
entries.zh: 法纳姆在外套里发现了一只儿童手套，这才意识到外套不是自己的。

entries.en: We left Somerville with the same broken suitcase we had intended to replace.
entries.zh: 我们离开萨默维尔时，带的还是那个本想换掉的坏行李箱。

entries.en: Saatchi shook the folded blanket and discovered that the missing watch was caught inside.
entries.zh: 萨奇抖开折好的毯子，发现不见的手表卡在里面。

entries.en: Patel steadied the rocking chair before the child climbed onto it.
entries.zh: 孩子爬上摇椅之前，帕特尔先把椅子扶稳了。

entries.en: Courtney packed the spoons separately so that they would not scratch the painted box.
entries.zh: 考特尼把勺子另装一包，免得刮花涂了漆的盒子。

entries.en: Cirencester helped untangle the kite string from the branch above the gate.
entries.zh: 赛伦塞斯特帮忙解开了缠在门上方树枝上的风筝线。

entries.en: Mowbray lifted the wet mat to check whether the floor beneath it was stained.
entries.zh: 莫布雷掀起湿垫子，查看下面的地板是否染上了污渍。

entries.en: Hatton balanced a saucepan beneath the leak and went to find a towel.
entries.zh: 哈顿把煮锅稳稳放在漏水处下方，然后去找毛巾。

entries.meaningZh: 米尔沃尔足球俱乐部〔球队名〕
entries.en: She tucked an old Millwall programme into the pocket of her winter coat.
entries.zh: 她把一本米尔沃尔足球俱乐部的旧比赛节目册塞进了冬外套口袋。

entries.en: Brentford held the jar tightly while I tried to loosen its stubborn lid.
entries.zh: 我试着拧开难开的罐盖时，布伦特福德紧紧握住罐子。

entries.en: Richie rescued the paper boat just before it floated into the drain.
entries.zh: 里奇赶在纸船漂进排水口之前把它捞了起来。

entries.meaningZh: 格拉斯顿伯里音乐节〔活动名〕
entries.en: Her old Glastonbury wristband was tucked inside a photograph album.
entries.zh: 她那条旧的格拉斯顿伯里音乐节腕带夹在一本相册里。

entries.en: The box delivered to our flat in Chiswick contained somebody else's curtains.
entries.zh: 有个箱子送到了我们在奇斯威克的公寓，里面装着别人的窗帘。

entries.en: A Hennessy box on the shelf held buttons and several old keys.
entries.zh: 搁架上的一个轩尼诗包装盒里装着纽扣和几把旧钥匙。

entries.en: Asquith left the muddy boots outside and entered the kitchen in his socks.
entries.zh: 阿斯奎思把沾泥的靴子留在外面，脚上只穿袜子走进厨房。

entries.en: Our weekend in Aberystwyth began with a search for the keys to the rented flat.
entries.zh: 我们在阿伯里斯特威斯度周末的第一件事，就是找租住公寓的钥匙。

entries.en: Wickham picked the envelope up by its dry corner to avoid smudging the address.
entries.zh: 威克姆捏住信封干燥的一角，把它拿起来，以免弄花地址。

entries.en: Denning stood on the empty crate to reach the jammed window catch.
entries.zh: 丹宁站到空木箱上，去够卡住的窗扣。

entries.en: Kirsty pushed the blanket beneath the door to keep the draught away from the kitten.
entries.zh: 柯丝蒂把毯子塞到门下，挡住吹向小猫的冷风。

entries.en: Marcos noticed the torn pocket only after the last coin had fallen out.
entries.zh: 最后一枚硬币掉出来后，马科斯才注意到口袋破了。

entries.en: Our friends in Newham lent us a ladder long enough to reach the attic hatch.
entries.zh: 我们在纽汉的朋友借给我们一架梯子，足够长，能让我们够到阁楼口。

entries.en: Michele removed the wet wrapping paper without tearing the letter hidden beneath it.
entries.zh: 米歇尔揭去湿包装纸，没有撕坏藏在下面的信。

entries.en: Easton pressed the cupboard door closed until I could fasten the loose hinge.
entries.zh: 伊斯顿按住关上的柜门，直到我能把松动的铰链固定好。

entries.en: Gazza waited beneath the porch while we searched for a dry towel.
entries.zh: 我们寻找干毛巾时，加扎在门廊下等着。

entries.en: Skelton caught the falling vase but spilled its water across the unopened letters.
entries.zh: 斯凯尔顿接住了掉落的花瓶，却把水洒在了尚未拆开的信上。

entries.en: Marr shook his head when I offered to help carry the enormous suitcase.
entries.zh: 我提出帮忙抬那个硕大的行李箱时，马尔摇了摇头。

entries.en: Naylor folded the broken umbrella and put it beneath his seat.
entries.zh: 内勒收起坏伞，把它放到了座位下面。

entries.en: Dyson held the kitten while I untangled the ribbon from its paw.
entries.zh: 我解开缠在小猫爪子上的丝带时，戴森抱着小猫。

entries.en: Ferranti opened the suitcase on the floor after hearing the bottles clink inside.
entries.zh: 费兰蒂听见箱内瓶子碰响，便在地板上打开了行李箱。

entries.en: Frome removed his gloves to untie the knot in the wet parcel string.
entries.zh: 弗罗姆脱下手套，去解湿包裹绳上的结。

entries.en: A bundle of old letters from Roxburgh lay beneath the travel journals.
entries.zh: 那些旅行日记下面，放着一捆从罗克斯巴勒郡寄来的旧信。

entries.en: The torn ticket from Anfield was still inside the pocket of his raincoat.
entries.zh: 那张安菲尔德球场的破票仍在他的雨衣口袋里。

entries.en: Liza covered the bowl with a plate before carrying it through the crowded room.
entries.zh: 莉莎用盘子盖住碗，才端着它穿过拥挤的房间。
